patches.reason: The second script shows mandys_blackmail/co2.jpg, which the image pack lacks; the pack carries short-name copies that are byte-identical to the zero-padded ones (co1 = co01, co3 = co03, co9 = co09), and co02.jpg exists. Use co02.jpg.

The German script's "hard enough" button reads loadBoolean("Hart.female"), a key nothing saves, so every player got the male button; every other gendered button in this script and its siblings reads intro.female, which the profile saves. Read intro.female.

Legacy bug (creator report): after the email question, an address that contains the player's name or first name gets "Not yours!" and one more getString, whose answer was not checked again, so a short or empty answer stopped the script at str_email[2] (V2 explorer: TSR025); and the name check read loadString("mandys_blackmail.firstname"), missing where the player skipped that part, which Groovy failed on (null) and the conversion reads as "", which every address contains, so it always said "Not yours!". Evident intent: re-ask inside the same email validation, and compare with a name only when one is known. The patch repeats both checks until they pass and skips an unknown name, in Mandys_blackmail.groovy, Mandys_blackmail_ext.groovy, and mandys_blackmail.groovy, which share the code.
